purpose: GAP-30: re-run the R6 tier-aware live sweep with the tier source changed from the frozen Wave 161 metrics to each seed's OWN fresh baseline fold (the record's actual baseline quality), for both the as-designed (easy beta 0.75) and faithful (easy beta 0.25) directions.
gpu_note: GPU0 only (the recorded R6 directive). GPU0 was free at launch.
command_executed: Six concurrent single-seed invocations (2 arms x 3 seeds); the baseline FASTAs + folds are reused verbatim from gap28-r6-faithful (bare-RNG seed-deterministic).
pairing: within-seed fresh baseline fold (reused from gap28-r6-faithful)
tier_assignment_rule: quantile boundaries DEFAULT_TIER_QUANTILES (0.33, 0.67) computed from the reference baseline (the wrapper's own rule), so the 'fresh' group is exactly the record set the wrapper damps
tier_isolation: exact: for all 3 seeds the framework FASTAs of the two arms differ on exactly the 330 fresh-quantile-easy records (0 elsewhere)
